# Nhaav — robots policy
#
# Only the public marketing pages are crawlable. The marketplace, company
# profiles, dashboards, payments and the admin console are authenticated
# surfaces containing private business data, so they are disallowed here and
# also send `X-Robots-Tag: noindex` from the host (.htaccess) and a
# `<meta name="robots">` tag from the app.
#
# Update the Sitemap line if the production domain changes.

User-agent: *
Allow: /$
Allow: /about
Allow: /pricing
Allow: /services
Allow: /terms

Disallow: /admin
Disallow: /dashboard
Disallow: /marketplace
Disallow: /company
Disallow: /provider
Disallow: /supplier
Disallow: /supplies
Disallow: /ship-dashboard
Disallow: /ship-owner
Disallow: /provider-dashboard
Disallow: /supplier-dashboard
Disallow: /my-quotations
Disallow: /procurement-opportunities
Disallow: /submit-quotation
Disallow: /compare-quotations
Disallow: /create-request
Disallow: /request
Disallow: /payments
Disallow: /notifications
Disallow: /orders
Disallow: /jobs
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /settings
Disallow: /verification
Disallow: /analytics
Disallow: /financials
Disallow: /success
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /register
Disallow: /choose-role
Disallow: /role
Disallow: /forgot-password
Disallow: /reset-password
Disallow: /verify-email
Disallow: /resend-verification

Sitemap: https://nhaav.com/sitemap.xml
